identity.name: DHFR replica ensembles on one GPU: sequential versus concurrent execution
identity.brief_workload: Fixed-work eight-replica adaptation, driver printed in brief
identity.distinction: Public code, command and inputs exist for the parent benchmark. Fixed-work driver and predictions come from the brief; no independent published fixed-work result is established.

outcome_definition.primary: Minimize elapsed wall seconds for all eight replicas on one GPU with fixed scientific work and unchanged per-replica outcomes.

components.component: OpenMM API, Reference and CPU platforms
PDB and force-field inputs distributed with OpenMM
components.licence: Repository distribution; brief explicitly permits local running and modification

source_licences.conditions: Retain applicable copyright and licence notices; comply with LGPL if redistributing modifications.
source_licences.brief_driver_permission_evidence: Brief supplies driver for local running and modification.

stock_cuda_image.reason: Stock image manifest, host driver and MPS executable availability not supplied or tested. Wheels establish a plausible installation route, not verified image compatibility.
requirements: Linux x86_64 with compatible manylinux ABI
One NVIDIA GPU; MPS support and control binary for concurrent method
stock_cuda_image.cuda_plugin_dependencies: PyPI metadata declares NVIDIA CUDA runtime, nvcc, NVRTC, CUPTI and cuFFT wheels; transitive versions are not pinned.

memory.data_scope: PDB plus two force-field XML files only; excludes installed software.
memory.reason: No published or measured peak host/device working set for eight concurrent replicas.

scoring.performance: Report ensemble wall time, aggregate throughput and speedup at identical fixed work, device and environment.
scoring.reason: NVIDIA observations have no acceptance tolerances; brief speedup ranges are hypotheses, not published acceptance criteria.
scoring.scientific_outcome_rule: Brief requests identical energy series; fallback compares mean potential energy against same-seed sequential run-to-run variation.
scoring.fallback_reason: No CUDA repeats, variation estimate or numeric scientific tolerance supplied. Do not derive tolerance from publication uncertainty.
scoring.constraint_tolerance_note: Integrator constraint tolerance is a model setting, not a result acceptance tolerance.

repeatability.seed_use: Initial velocities and integrator stream for replica i use 1000+i.
controls: Identical step count and energy sampling
repeatability.limitations: Documented deterministic forces do not establish tested bit-identical stochastic trajectories under concurrency. Brief reports only a small CPU test; CUDA reproduction remains pending.

search_note: Opened only brief-named sources and their pinned raw files; no alternative benchmark search.
